en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style view over open fields toward a small town. In the middle distance stands a church with a tall, tiered tower and spire, surrounded by long, low buildings and a mix of houses and industrial chimneys. Bare trees line a road or path in front of the settlement. At the top in red Gothic-style script is printed the caption identifying the place and church.
